For software developers, payers, transmitters and tax professionals. Subscribe to QuickAlerts We use your email address to send your subscribed updates and let you manage your subscription. Find details on IRS privacy guidance about email contact . Subscription topics Subscribe to updates on any of these topics: Alerts – Processing delays, programming problems, changes to filing season procedures, error reject code and business rules information Technical information – Schema and software testing (ATS and PATS) General notifications – Seminars, conferences, e-file publication changes IRS e-file service center – E-file program updates, service center maintenance schedules, IRS e-file help desk phone numbers and general information Affordable Care Act Information Return (AIR) System – Specifications, updates and publications for issuers, payers, transmitters and software developers to e-file Forms 1094B, 1095B, 1094C and 1095C to the IRS Information Returns Intake System (IRIS) – Specifications, updates and publications for issuers, payers, transmitters and software developers to e-file Forms 1099 to the IRS QuickAlerts archive Find an archive of updates from the past 12 months in the QuickAlerts archive . How to change your subscription To change or cancel your subscription, select the Subscriber Preference link at the bottom of the QuickAlert email. Help If you have questions or problems with the subscription service, please contact subscriber help . For an e-file related issue, email quickalerts@irs.gov . Our response may be delayed during filing season. Thank you for your patience. Page Last Reviewed or Updated: 17-Mar-2026 Share Facebook Twitter Linkedin Print
